targetTest: CR-01: scrubbing a multi-user_info line is a fixed point (re-scrub is byte-identical)
expected: Scrubbing the already-scrubbed output of a multi-user_info line is byte-identical (fixed point), per the documented idempotency contract.
actual: FAILED as intended: pass 1 leaked the second user_info payload; pass 2 redacted it, so second.out differed from first.out (TAP diff shows the verbatim email in expected-pass-1 output).
semanticAssessment: Target executed and failed on its own planned assertion (ERR_ASSERTION, failureType testCodeFailure — not a load/fixture/syntax fault). Test A: the SECOND user_info payload survived verbatim as an object (stale lastIndex skipped it), proving the CR-01 leak. Test B: pass 1 left the second payload, pass 2 redacted it, so re-scrub was not byte-identical — the documented fixed-point contract is violated. The 18 pre-existing tests all passed, so the failures are attributable to the new regression coverage alone.
